<thought>We need to apply the retrosynthetic template that breaks the central C=C bond of the target stilbene derivative into two aromatic fragments. From the template search, the first matching template has the hash “fc9c157e0d3e99d81e866126332f0e03963252aac407346a09606af202ca7ff6”. Using this as the template identifier, we apply it to the target SMILES C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2. The application yields two identical anisole fragments (COc1ccccc1). Therefore the list of possible precursor combinations is [["COc1ccccc1", "COc1ccccc1"]].</thought>
<final_answer>[["COc1ccccc1", "COc1ccccc1"]]</final_answer>
